home.assessBody: 10–15 questions (finance + programming + interests) recommend your starting level. Coming in M1.
home.mapLegend: The six levels are the recommended order; open a level to see its units. Levels light up as you pass them; a greyed level is best saved for after the previous one, but every page stays open.
home.mapSignInHint: Sign in and the map will show your progress.
home.lockedHint: Pass {level} first; the content is already open if you want to look ahead.

learn.title: Learning
learn.subtitle: Three parallel tracks — not a prerequisite chain. Order is guided by the Level system on the learning map.
learn.tradingDesc: From reading quotes, order books and trading apps to simulated trading, strategy tuning, and an overview of automated & high-frequency trading systems.
learn.researchDesc: From what factor mining is, through the math and finance basics, to a full classic-factor workflow, paper replication and competitions.
learn.codeDesc: Hands-on Python & pandas with auto-graded assignments — everything in-site, no external links.

trading.title: Trading Track
trading.subtitle: Five stages: Stages 1–4 form the main line (each gated by the previous quiz); Stage 5 is a knowledge extension.

research.title: Research Track
research.subtitle: Five layers: from concept to a complete workflow, then paper replication and competition exits.

code.title: Coding Track
code.subtitle: 8 lessons covering L1–L3. Step-by-step courses with auto-graded assignments, fully in-site.

assignments.title: Assignments & Practice
assignments.subtitle: Shared across all tracks: submissions, auto-grading, and a mistake notebook.
assignments.colSubmitDesc: Submit code assignments in the browser; hidden test cases judge instantly; unlimited retries.
assignments.colJudgeDesc: Code tasks run tests in-browser (Pyodide); concept quizzes are graded instantly.
assignments.colWrongDesc: Wrong answers are collected automatically with links back to the relevant sections.

assignmentCenter.anonymousTitle: Log in to see your learning records
assignmentCenter.anonymousBody: You can use the grader without an account. Log in to save code submissions and quizzes, and collect mistakes here automatically.
assignmentCenter.unlimitedRetries: Unlimited attempts; every run executes all tests for your parameter variant.
assignmentCenter.runtimeLoading: Loading Python and the data-analysis libraries; the first load may take a while…
assignmentCenter.runtimeError: The Python runtime could not load. Refresh and try again.
assignmentCenter.notPassed: You passed {passed}/{total} tests. Compare the difference, edit, and retry immediately.
assignmentCenter.saveSaved: This submission is now in your records.
assignmentCenter.quizSaved: Quiz saved; any wrong answers are now in your Mistake Notebook.
assignmentCenter.saveAnon: This result stays on the current page only. Log in before submitting to save it to your account.
assignmentCenter.saveError: Grading finished, but the record was not saved. Check your connection and resubmit; if this persists, the database migration is still required.
assignmentCenter.supportTitle: Three unsuccessful attempts: try a different way forward
assignmentCenter.supportBody: Review the linked section, note what you do not understand and what you tried, then email QFS to arrange office hours or a Workshop. You can still retry — the task never locks.
assignmentCenter.loadError: Records are unavailable. Make sure 0003_assignments_and_quizzes.sql has been run, then refresh and retry.
assignmentCenter.noHistory: No records yet. Complete a graded assignment or quiz to see it here.
assignmentCenter.mistakeSummary: Grouped by question. A latest correct answer marks it mastered while preserving its history.
assignmentCenter.noMistakesBody: Incorrect answers appear here; a later correct answer moves them to Mastered.
assignmentCenter.noMasteredBody: Questions you once missed and later answered correctly remain here as part of your learning history.
